Pillar 4 of 4

STL file fundamentals

An STL stores only the surface triangles of a model — no units, no scale and no material. So the number you see when you import one is just a measurement in your slicer's default units. Check the bounding box, confirm the unit, then apply a scale from a stated baseline.

Most scaling mistakes happen before the slicer percentage is typed in: the file was exported in metres, the sculptor used a different measurement convention, or the model includes a base you forgot to subtract. These guides and browser-only tools help you catch that first. Your files are never uploaded.
